authorization: The user delegated annotation decisions in the current project task.

relevance.2: Directly asks for the concrete technical object, condition or operation in the query.
relevance.1: Explicitly related but asks about a broader mechanism or adjacent condition.
relevance.0: No selected source-grounded relevance; sharing a broad domain alone is insufficient.
relevance.coverage: Reviewed source-catalogue searches and selected original evidence. Completeness is limited by this review; the benchmark is not a claim of universal semantic ground truth.

dedup.SAME: Same primary technical demand and answer boundary; wording and interview timing may differ.
dedup.RELATED: Shared topic but different operation, narrower constraints, ambiguous context or answer boundary.
dedup.DIFFERENT: Different primary technical demand even when wording or domain overlaps.

routing: Author scenario requirements before inference. Check actual rows, state, invocation sequence, authorization and idempotency instead of an agent-reported success flag.
splits: Keep feedback in dev. Hold out scenario families together; do not fit a decision threshold on the final test set.
freeze: Store every label file hash. Changing a label creates a new dataset version; failures and superseded versions are retained.
